LanguageData.CC_Settings_FactionMemory_Tip: Every people out in the world keeps a memory of the colony: a prisoner set free, a wounded guest tended, gifts, fair trades, quests and missions done or failed, help in a plague or a famine, a camp helped or driven off, traders robbed, raiders killed, towns attacked, and what they did in turn (fighters sent when the colony called, raids, colonists killed). Each memory fades over the years, the big ones slowest, and a people keeps a dozen at most. Envoys come to repay an old debt or to call in a favor, old friends send relief in a hard time, an old enemy may offer peace once the feud has gone quiet for years, and a people may ask the colony to settle a quarrel. Raid letters name the old wrong the raiders remember, and the World page shows what each people remembers. Missions (an invitation, an apprentice, a dignitary, refugees) come either way, from the peoples that think best of the colony. Off: nothing new is remembered, and the envoys, relief, peace offers and quarrels don't come.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_FactionMemory: The neighbors remember debts, favors and grudges over the years, and act on them.
